mapProfile.cameraFraming: Keep the complete irregular oak-meadow basin, both loops, and every formation approach readable in the production isometric camera.

styleAuthority.usage: Use the image for Heartlands color, material, and pastoral woodland hierarchy; derive gameplay topology from this semantic contract.

composition.summary: An irregular Heartlands oak-meadow basin centered on a shallow loam hollow and dry streambed, with a western meadow, eastern coppice clearing, northern fieldstone overlook, and branching figure-eight paths.
visualHierarchy: The warm ochre loam hollow and dry streambed form the low central seam and shared crossing space.
The broad western meadow balances the denser eastern coppice clearing as distinct formation grounds.
A low northern fieldstone overlook crowns the upper loop without becoming an isolated peak.
Oak, flowering hawthorn, field maple, and rounded fieldstone shape an organic pastoral boundary.
focalAreas: central shallow loam hollow and dry streambed
negativeSpace: Keep open breathing room within the western meadow and eastern coppice clearing for readable formations.
Preserve sightlines through the shallow hollow and around both figure-eight crossings.
Leave narrow natural gaps between hawthorn, oak, and fieldstone boundary clusters for alternate approaches.
density: Open warm meadow grass and bluebells across the western basin shelf.
Moderate coppiced oak, field maple, leaf litter, and low fieldstone density around the eastern clearing.
Denser oak and flowering hawthorn clusters along the irregular outer basin rim.
Sparse fieldstone accents on the northern overlook and beside streambed crossings.

areas.description: A broad, shallow loam depression and dry streambed that carries the middle crossing without functioning as a choke.
An irregular open meadow formation area with multiple exits into both halves of the figure-eight network.
A sheltered formation clearing edged by coppiced oak and field maple with distinct upper and lower approaches.
A broad low overlook backed by rounded fieldstone and reached by natural slopes or occasional fieldstone stairs.
A low path fork framed by flowering hawthorn that closes the lower loop and provides a second cross-basin route.

relationships.kind: two gently curving entries across the western lip of the dry streambed
paired streambed crossings that arrive from different angles
upper loop approach by a natural slope and a separate fieldstone stair
descending upper-loop branches around oak and fieldstone clusters
lower meadow branch with two readable exits
lower-loop coppice approach skirting the dry streambed
secondary branch that creates the lower figure-eight crossing
secondary upper branch that creates the northern crossing

connections: Use natural grassy or loamy slopes for most level changes.
Use occasional rounded fieldstone stairs where the upper loop meets the northern overlook.
Keep every rise broad and connected; do not create isolated peaks.
Let the dry streambed remain shallow enough to cross at several readable points.

primaryApproaches: Build two interlocking loops between the western meadow and eastern coppice clearing, crossing through the central hollow and reconnecting at northern and southern branches.
Give each formation area at least two tactically distinct approaches, with no route serving as the sole crossing.
Curve paths around oak, hawthorn, and fieldstone clusters instead of forming straight corridors.
secondaryApproaches: Link the northern overlook to both sides of the basin by a slope route and an occasional fieldstone-stair route.
Use the southern hawthorn fork and shallow streambed branches to preserve flanking choices around the lower loop.
Keep both figure-eight crossing spaces broad enough for alternate movement lines.

boundaryIntent.description: Organic oak, hawthorn, fieldstone, and natural slopes own an uneven Heartlands basin edge; never resolve the perimeter into a rectangle or continuous wall.

spawnIntent.formationCharacter: Opposing formations occupy the western meadow and eastern coppice clearing, each with local cover, open maneuvering room, and upper- and lower-loop exits.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not place candidates on detached pads.
Do not reserve full-height or full-width cleared spawn strips.
Do not make either formation depend on a single choke or crossing.
Do not infer exact spawn coordinates by literally tracing the source image.

requiredLandmarks: central shallow loam hollow and dry streambed
at least two crossings or approaches per formation
natural slopes and occasional fieldstone stairs

surfaces: warm ochre loam and leaf litter
decorations: oak and field maple leaf litter
